content.what_it_is: A V35/0x24 text-form compiler module-interface artifact for param, generated from mod_param.f90. It serializes named FUNWAVE physical constants, shared integer and real temporaries, and compiler symbol/attribute records (lines 1-54).
entities: param compiler-interface artifact generated from mod_param.f90 (lines 1-2)
pi, r_earth, small, large, grav, zero, rho_aw, rho_air, rho_water, and deg2rad named physical/numerical constants (lines 8-25)
Shared integer symbols i, j, k, res, and itmp1 through itmp5 (lines 27-35)
Shared real symbols tmp1 through tmp5 (lines 36-40)
Opaque compiler constant-value and symbol attribute records (lines 5-54)
unresolved: The V35/0x24 format does not define how the serialized integer payloads encode the values and kinds of sp, pi, r_earth, small, large, grav, zero, rho_aw, rho_air, rho_water, and deg2rad, so portable source-level numeric values cannot be recovered from this artifact alone (lines 6-25).
The meanings of the S/A/Z record fields, flags, offsets, and bit masks are not defined within the artifact (lines 5-54).
The timestamp 06/12/2026 does not state whether its date order is month/day or day/month (line 3).
